Basic tasks

← Back to contents

Opening an archive

Three ways, all equivalent:

  • drop the archive onto the window (or onto the menu bar icon);
  • press ⌘O, or click Open Archive in the toolbar;
  • double-click it in Finder — the common archive types are associated with this app.

Dropping several archives opens one window each. The contents appear as a table; the eight columns sort by clicking their headers, and right-clicking a header chooses which columns are shown.

Previewing a file inside

Select an item and press Space for a Quick Look preview, just like in Finder; double-clicking works too. Temporary files made for previews are cleaned up when the app quits.

Extracting

Press ⌘E, or click Extract To…. To extract only part of an archive, select those items first and use Extract Selected… from the context menu.

When the destination already contains a file of the same name, the compression panel decides what happens: overwrite, skip or rename automatically — the same three meanings as 7zz -ao.

Compressing

Press ⌘N (New Archive…), pick the files and a format. To add to an existing archive, open it first and press ⌘D (Add Files…).

Every compression setting lives in the Compression Options panel on the toolbar: format, level, method, dictionary size, word size, solid blocks, threads, volume size, encryption method, filename encryption and so on. The verify switch at the bottom left reads the archive back after writing it — worth turning on for data you care about.

Delete source files always moves files to the Trash rather than deleting them, so a mistake is recoverable. Compress separately creates one archive per input instead of a single one.

Deleting items inside an archive

Select them and press Delete, or use Delete in the context menu. 7-Zip deletes by rewriting the archive, so large archives take a while — progress is shown, and ⌘. stops it.

Encrypted archives and passwords

When you open an encrypted archive you can ask the app to remember the password. It is stored in the login keychain under the archive's full path, so you can inspect or remove it in Keychain Access. A wrong password is removed from the keychain automatically instead of being retried forever.

When creating an encrypted archive, encrypt file names is available for 7z only; other formats encrypt the contents but not the names.

Searching and the log

⌘F focuses the search field, which filters the current list by file name. Large archives are listed as they are read, so the tree keeps growing for a moment after the window opens.

⌘L shows or hides the log drawer. It holds the engine's raw output, which is what you want when reporting a problem. The View menu item for it carries a checkmark so its state is visible.

Keyboard shortcuts

ShortcutAction
⌘N / ⌘ONew archive / Open archive
⌘E / ⌘DExtract to… / Add files…
⌘TTest archive integrity
⌘FFocus the search field
SpacePreview the selected item
DeleteDelete the selected items
⌘.Stop the current task
